Solid metal plates resembling tormented faces cover all four sides of this handheld lantern Through the mouth- and eye-holes shines an eerie green light cast by a ghost magically trapped inside. The ghost starts whispering whenever a threat approaches within 10 meters of its "owner." The whispering imposes a –4 to stealth attempts but grants the owner a +4 to find tests to notice nearby danger. If the lantern is destroyed (Toughness 14) the ghost dissipates forever. Possessing the lantern for one full (very noisy) day transfers "ownership."
